The '''45th Golden Globes Awards''', honoring the best in [[1987 in film|film]] and [[1987 in American television|television]] of 1987, as chosen by the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association]]. The ceremony was held on January 23, 1988 at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]] and was produced by [[Dick Clark Productions]] and the HFPA.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Finke|first1=Nikki|title='Emperor' Reigns at Golden Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1988-01-25-ca-25651-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=25 January 1988}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Cher, Robin Williams Win Golden Globe Awards|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1988-01-24-mn-38167-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=24 January 1988}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Finke|first1=Nikki|title='Last Emperor' reigns supreme at surprising Golden Globe Awards|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1291&dat=19880125&id=WzFUAAAAIBAJ&sjid=vY0DAAAAIBAJ&pg=2029,7225525&hl=de|via=Google News Archive|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Boca Raton News|date=25 January 1988}}</ref> The nominations were announced on January 5, 1988.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Mathews|first1=Jack|title='Last Emperor' Garners Five Golden Globe Nominations|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1988-01-06-ca-22858-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=6 January 1988}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Films in close race for Globe awards|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1454&dat=19880106&id=p9dOAAAAIBAJ&sjid=wBMEAAAAIBAJ&pg=6925,1641726&hl=de|via=Google News Archive|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Star-News|date=6 January 1988}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Nominees Announced For 1988 Golden Globes|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1988/01/06/movies/nominees-announced-for-1988-golden-globes.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=6 January 1988}}</ref>
